reuse.why: The new action reuses the existing category policy, signed-amount conversion, month utilities, budget writer, batching, and undo wrappers.

duplication.why: Eligibility and amount-sign decisions remain shared, and the redundant SQL hidden-category filtering is removed.

placement.why: Category policy stays in month-action-categories.ts, action orchestration stays in actions.ts, and method registration stays in app.ts.

scope.why: All edits concern month-wide budget actions, their shared selection policy, method registration, or a focused test.

maintainability.why: The shared policy remains easy to extend, although the unused action parameter in the predicate and repeated undefined positional arguments make its interface less clear.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All affected month-wide actions use getMonthBudgetCategories or shouldIncludeMonthBudgetCategory, and the new action uses averageToBudgetAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: No renamed or reshaped copies of eligibility or amount-conversion logic are introduced.

abstraction_drift.where: includeHiddenCategories is added to both shared selection functions; it expresses the requested variation without introducing action-specific branches or bypassing consumers.
